components.css: .ds-option { min-height: 68px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #dedee3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1f1f24; font: 400 14px/1.45 Sora, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-option-mark { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 22px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f0f0f3; color: #6b6b76; font: 400 11px JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: #1f1f24; } .ds-option[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #1f1f24; background: #1f1f24; color: #f3f3f5; } .ds-option[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-option-mark { background: #fff; color: #1f1f24; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f1f24; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prompt Card

components.css: .ds-prompt { width: 360px; overflow: hidden; border: 1.5px solid #dedee3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #1f1f24; font-family: Sora, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-prompt-head { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ececf0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 13px; } .ds-prompt-copy { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1.5px solid #dedee3; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1f1f24; font: 600 12px Sora, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms, background 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-prompt-copy:hover { border-color: #1f1f24; } .ds-prompt-copy:active { background: #1f1f24; color: #fff; } .ds-prompt-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f1f24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-prompt-body { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; color: #3a3a42; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; }

components.name: Score Row
components.description: A VARK score label, measured value, and animated semantic bar.
components.css: .ds-score { width: 360px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px 14px; color: #1f1f24; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-score-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-score-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #af52de; } .ds-score-value { color: #5b5b66; font: 400 13px JetBrains Mono, monospace; } .ds-score-track { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 5px; background: #e2e2e7; } .ds-score-fill { width: 42%; height: 100%; border-radius: 5px; background: #af52de; transition: width 600ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }

components.name: Editorial Panel
components.description: The rounded, expanding rail unit with measured sequence labeling.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 260px; min-height: 420px; padding: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20,20,26,0) 30%, rgba(20,20,26,.78)), #1a1a20; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: flex 550ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), filter 550ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-panel-number { opacity: .7; font: 400 12px JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-panel-title { margin-top: 8px; font: 600 36px/1 Sora, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-panel:hover { filter: saturate(1.08); } .ds-panel:active { filter: saturate(.95); } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f1f24; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
VARK Panels is a restrained assessment workspace set on a cool light-slate field. Dark ink controls and white utility surfaces keep the reading and decision layer quiet, while a fourteen-image rail supplies the color, pace, and sense of progression. The artifact is intentionally light-only.

The visual system serves a stateless thirteen-scenario path from orientation through results and prompt copying. Its distinctive behavior is spatial: one stable instructional column works beside a rail whose images move between overview, active detail, and completed-state saturation.

The fourteen shipping WebP rasters are derived from the owner-approved design PNG sequence, preserved in source order by `src/data/panels.ts`, and optimized to 720×1201 WebP files with the recorded build command `cwebp -q 78 -resize 720 0`. They are repository-owned build assets; no external stock provider or generative source is asserted by the shipped code.
keyCharacteristics: Light slate canvas with near-black ink and white working surfaces.
Saturated editorial imagery is concentrated in the navigable rail.
Sora carries reading and action; JetBrains Mono carries measurements and progress.
One active panel expands while the surrounding sequence remains visible.
States remain explicit through fill, border, saturation, labels, and copy feedback.

rules.name: The Color Lives in Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep the assessment chrome achromatic; use saturated hues for VARK data and shipped editorial images, not decorative interface accents.

rules.name: The State Is Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Pair color changes with fill, border, checkmark, text, saturation, or explicit labels.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Sora owns reading and actions; JetBrains Mono is reserved for quantities, sequence, progress, and keyboard notation.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Display and headline type use semibold weight with negative tracking; body copy returns to regular weight and comfortable leading.

rules.name: The Contextual Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Keep the small uppercase JetBrains Mono eyebrow above each panels-view heading. This is a user-pinned part of the VARK Panels direction; use it for route, question, and score context within this screen rather than as a generic site-wide decoration.

rules.name: The Stable Action Rule
rules.body: Changing questions must not move the primary navigation controls at desktop widths.

rules.name: The Topology Switch Rule
rules.body: Desktop is a side-by-side editorial rail; mobile is an aside followed by stacked strips. Do not compress the desktop rail into unusable slivers.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient card shadows; use borders, surface contrast, and motion to separate interactive layers.

rules.name: The Radius by Scale Rule
rules.body: Small internal marks are tighter, controls are 12px, and image panels are 20px. Larger radius communicates larger physical scale, not increased decoration.

dos: Do preserve the achromatic workspace and let editorial images and score data carry saturation.
Do keep the full fourteen-step rail legible while one panel expands.
Do use Sora for prose/actions and JetBrains Mono for measurable state.
Do expose selected, disabled, progress, current-step, and copied states semantically.
Do retain the 1100px topology switch and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve raster order, 720×1201 dimensions, and owner-approved image subjects when replacing encoded assets; record any new source and transformation provenance.
donts: Don't add dark mode, ambient shadows, or decorative interface gradients to this light-only flat workspace.
Don't use VARK colors as generic brand accents or rely on hue alone to communicate state.
Don't hide the rail sequence when a panel expands or force vertical desktop labels onto mobile.
Don't introduce additional display or monospace families.
Don't remove, restyle, or relocate the user-pinned contextual eyebrows in the VARK Panels screen; outside that screen, do not apply them as generic decoration.
